mapper.sql: WITH alt_monitoring_data_his AS ( SELECT date_str, data_type, channel_id, client_id, task_id, IF(data_type = 'metaData', data_size, 0) AS metaData_data_size, IF(data_type = 'nlpData', data_size, 0) AS nlpData_data_size FROM (SELECT f1.date_str, f1.data_type, f1.channel_id, c1.task_id, f1.client_id, IF(c1.data_size IS NULL, 0, c1.data_size) AS data_size FROM ( /** 补齐时间 **/ WITH st AS (SELECT to_date(days_add(start_date, unnest)) AS start_date FROM (SELECT array_generate(0, day_diff, 1) AS index_, start_date, end_date FROM (SELECT *, date_diff('day', end_date, start_date) AS day_diff FROM (SELECT to_date(min(create_time)) AS start_date, to_date(max(create_time)) AS end_date FROM alt_monitoring_data) f) f) f, unnest(index_) AS unnest) SELECT s.start_date AS date_str, data_type, channel_id, client_id FROM st AS s, /** 补齐渠道 **/ (SELECT channel_id, client_id FROM alt_task_config_data GROUP BY channel_id, client_id) f, /** 补齐数据源 **/ (SELECT unnest AS data_type FROM (SELECT [ 'nlpData', 'metaData' ] d) f, unnest(d)) e GROUP BY s.start_date, channel_id, client_id, data_type ORDER BY start_date DESC, data_type) f1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_date(create_time) AS date_str, max(data_size) AS data_size, task_id, channel_id, client_id, data_type FROM alt_monitoring_data WHERE /** 存在重复数据时取最新数据行数据 **/ create_time IN (SELECT max(create_time) FROM alt_monitoring_data GROUP BY to_date(create_time), client_id, channel_id, data_type) GROUP BY to_date(create_time), data_type, task_id, channel_id, client_id ORDER BY to_date(create_time) DESC, data_type) AS c1 ON f1.date_str = c1.date_str AND f1.channel_id = c1.channel_id AND f1.data_type = c1.data_type ORDER BY date_str DESC) f1 ORDER BY date_str DESC, data_type, channel_id, client_id)

select channel_id, client_id, avg(metaData_data_size) as his_metaData_avg , avg(nlpData_data_size) as his_nlpData_avg from alt_monitoring_data_his where to_date(#{model.createTime}) > to_date(date_str) group by client_id, channel_id

SELECT task.channel_id, task.client_id, task.period_number, IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(his_metaData.metaData_data_size), 0) / IFNULL(SUM(his_metaData.nlpData_data_size), 0), 0) / task.period_number AS his_diff_nlpData_avg FROM alt_task_config_data task left join alt_monitoring_data_his his_metaData on his_metaData.date_str BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL task.period_number DAY) AND CURDATE() AND his_metaData.task_id = task.id WHERE task.data_type != 'pushData' group by task.channel_id, task.client_id, task.period_number

select channel_id, client_id, sum(if(nlpData_data_size = 0, 0, nlpData_data_size)) as today_nlpData, sum(if(metaData_data_size = 0, 0, metaData_data_size)) as today_metaData from alt_monitoring_data_his where to_date(date_str) = to_date(#{model.createTime}) group by client_id,channel_id
